name: Pantheon UMI
summary: A collection operation combining freeform manipulation, scripted tasks, and failure episodes with automated annotation.
scale: 1M+ recorded tasks reported · 100 h sample announced
representation: UMI demonstrations with task and phase annotations
access: 100 h sample announced; download not verified
notes: Recorded task instances are not benchmark task classes. The full reported corpus is distinct from the announced sample.

name: Argus
summary: An annotation and quality pipeline that reads multi-view episodes in their original formats and exports dense timelines.
representation: Timeline labels, outcomes, goal frames, and quality flags
access: Public code and episode annotation exports
notes: Model-generated audits are evidence to inspect, not ground-truth rankings of datasets.

name: UMI Arena
summary: A shared-robot evaluation protocol for transferring handheld demonstrations to real-world manipulation policies.
notes: Five evaluation tasks are published and three are held out. The planned 20,000-hour corpus is a target, not the released portion.

name: N0-Foundation / OpenNeoData
summary: A vision–tactile data system connecting collection hardware, mixed robot and UMI demonstrations, and evaluation.
representation: UMI end-effector actions; platform-specific robot joint actions
notes: The 30K-hour N0 report corpus differs from the 5K+ hour mixed OpenNeoData release. UMI-only hours are not established.
